blurb: Guests take a 20-minute plane ride to 10,500 feet, then experience 45 seconds of freefall at 120 mph followed by a 5-7 minute parachute ride over the Gulf of Mexico. The dropzone is located on a private airfield near the Florida-Alabama coastline. They offer tandem skydiving packages, photo and video packages, and special proposal packages.
extraNote: No refunds if you decide not to jump after paying · Rescheduling allowed with 48 hours notice or if canceled due to weather · Guests must arrive at their reservation time · Tipping is not required but appreciated · Private airfield at 28502 Frank Rd., Elberta, AL 36530
